issues: React accessibility warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — non-blocking, but shadcn Dialog should include a DialogDescription for screen-reader compliance.

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y: add <DialogDescription> to the Update Goal dialog (and any other DialogContent without one) to silence the shadcn-radix warning about aria-describedby.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 3936 lines — still well past the 700-line guideline; the goals section (~120 lines) is a good candidate for extraction into backend/routers/goals.py alongside the helpers _goal_change_ops and _notify_leadership_goal.
Frontend GoalCard.jsx: quick slider uses onMouseUp AND onTouchEnd but not onKeyUp — keyboard users won't fire the PUT (accessibility gap for range input).
GoalCard dialog Save Note button only guards against 'no change' locally; the backend correctly returns 400 for empty payloads (validated).

Notes are pushed with $push (unbounded array growth) — for a long-lived goal with dozens of notes/history rows the goal document could balloon. Consider a soft cap or migrating to a separate goal_notes collection long-term.
